events.headline: RUSSIAN WARSHIP HIT BY UKRAINIAN DRONE IN GULF OF FINLAND
events.detail: The attack is thought to be the first time Ukrainian drones have attacked a Russian ship in an open stretch of the Baltic Sea.

events.headline: EIGHT KILLED IN COLOMBIAN AIR STRIKE TARGETING GULF CLAN GANG
events.detail: A suspected gang leader considered a "priority target" was among those killed, the Colombian president says.
